prompt: Concept: one household answering the national housing survey speaks for hundreds of other homes. An ordinary South Korean residential neighborhood after dark, seen from a quiet alley at a slightly low frontal viewpoint: a tightly packed, varied mix of Korean homes stacked up the frame like one big portrait of how people live — a mid-rise apartment block on one side, three- and four-storey red-brick villa (dasedae) buildings with exterior stairs, a small rooftop room (oktapbang) with a water tank and a laundry line on a roof, a half-basement (banjiha) window at ground level, a small old single-storey house with a tiled roof. Every window in every building glows the same warm amber, many many windows, as if all of them were lit by one source. At the bottom, slightly right of center, the front door of a small villa entrance is open, spilling a warm rectangle of light onto the alley pavement; in that doorway, two small figures seen from the side/back: a resident in a cardigan standing in the doorway and a survey interviewer in a plain navy jacket holding a small blank tablet, both small (no faces detailed, no badges, no lanyards text). A bicycle and a few potted plants by the wall. The door light and the windows share the same amber ink, connecting them visually.
style: Hand-made print-shop poster illustration, NOT a 3D render, NOT a glossy digital painting, NOT a photo, NOT vector clip-art. Matte opaque gouache on warm cold-press paper with visible dry-brush strokes and slightly uneven flat color fields, printed like a three-color risograph: fine grain, very slight ink misregistration at shape edges. Strict limited palette: deep night indigo blue, a darker blue-black for shadows, off-white cream paper, and ONE warm amber / apricot lamplight ink used ONLY for lit windows and the light of one open front door (lit windows are all the same warm amber, they are the brightest things in the picture). Low saturation elsewhere. Simple confident shapes, selective detail, simplified background. Lighting: early evening just after dark, soft and quiet; no moon glare, no stars cluster. Composition: asymmetric vertical poster; the TOP 38% of the frame is calm empty night sky with only soft paper grain (space for a headline added later); the subject sits in the lower 60%. Correct, simple perspective; buildings have solid believable construction, windows aligned in straight rows. AVOID: glossy highlights, plastic shine, oversaturated colors, lens flare, light rays, bokeh, symmetrical centered composition, HDR look, excessive tiny details, repeated cloned textures, cute mascot style, faces with detailed features. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage, no house numbers, no shop signs, no posters on walls anywhere.
